tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page, modal and drawer background. The ground everything else sits on.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Resting fill for activity cards, option rows and timeline events.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Category (accordion) headers; hover on surface-100 rows; the alternate band of the day strip.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Pressed state on rows and buttons. Use ink, never ink-muted, for text on it in dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers, hour lines on the timeline, the drawer divider. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls: inputs, selects, chips, secondary and unavailable buttons. At least 3:1 on bg and surface-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, icons and the category patterns. At least 15:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text: card sub text, hints, durations, hour labels. At least 4.5:1 on bg, surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: inverse-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button, floating action button, selected chips and days, toasts.

tokens.name: inverse-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverse-bg.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the navigation drawer and dialogs.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Screen and modal titles: Add activity, Review your diary, Thank you.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Step titles inside a modal; the app name in the top bar.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Category headers, day headings in the review list.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Eating, drinking, personal care, household routines
styles.usage: Default text. Also the minimum size for inputs and selects (avoids zoom on iOS).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Activity card headings, option labels, button labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Activity card sub text, hints under fields, notice text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chip labels, the save status.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary metadata only. Never the only place a fact is stated.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Hour labels on the timeline. Tabular figures keep the column straight.

styles.name: time-lg
styles.usage: Time ranges in events, the review list and the time step.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its hint; icon-to-text inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked activity cards; inner gap in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card and option row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card horizontal padding; FAB distance from edges.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between field groups in a modal; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of the review list.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top and bottom breathing room on confirmation screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Clearance under the last timeline hour so the FAB never covers content.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Timeline grid, top bar, full-screen modal.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Category pattern swatches, chips inside dense grids, timeline events.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, activity cards, option rows, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Category accordion groups; bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Floating action button, day chips, the save status.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar once the page scrolls.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Floating action button and the navigation drawer.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: fab
tokens.usage: Diameter of the floating action button.

tokens.name: hour-row
tokens.usage: Height of one hour on the timeline: 16px per 15-minute step.

tokens.name: quarter
tokens.usage: Height of one 15-minute step. Event top and height are multiples of it.

tokens.name: gutter-time
tokens.usage: Width of the hour-label column on the timeline: the 16px side margin plus the label.

tokens.name: swatch
tokens.usage: Side of the category pattern swatch on activity cards.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the main column on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: z-topbar
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar and sticky day headers.

tokens.name: z-fab
tokens.usage: Floating action button.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Drawer and modal when not rendered as a top-layer dialog.
